app.py.name: Flask catalog handlers
app.py.description: Renders list/detail/add/edit pages, reads request.form, commits additions/updates, and deletes via GET /delete/<id>. Also exposes a static demonstration response and 404 template; no auth or CSRF protection appears in these handlers.

models.py.name: Flask and Pet mapping
models.py.description: Constructs Flask and SQLAlchemy with SQLite storage; Pet defines identification, timestamps, appearance, image, adoption attributes and description.

templates/layout.html.name: Shared pet-page shell
templates/layout.html.description: Provides the catalog header, child button/content blocks, local CSS and external icon resources.

templates/index.html.name: Pet cards list
templates/index.html.description: Loops over pets to render image, name, age and description with detail links.

templates/pet.html.name: Pet detail and actions
templates/pet.html.description: Renders one pet and links to edit and deletion; the delete link targets a state-changing GET route.

templates/addpet.html.name: Add-pet form
templates/addpet.html.description: Posts appearance, image, type, gender, care flags and description fields to add_pet and loads the radio-icon helper.

templates/editpet.html.name: Prepopulated pet editor
templates/editpet.html.description: Posts the same pet fields to edit_pet with current values and selected radio states.

templates/404.html.name: Missing-pet view
templates/404.html.description: Extends layout with an error message, home/add navigation and an external animated image.

static/js/app.js.name: Radio-icon interaction
static/js/app.js.description: Registers load-time click handlers on check-circle icons and toggles a nearby input. No network fetches are implemented here.

static/css/styles.css.name: Pet catalog presentation
static/css/styles.css.description: Defines catalog header, cards, detail layout, form controls and responsive page styling.

README.md.name: Flask course overview
README.md.description: States the pet-management lesson stack and run instructions; not proof of deployed behavior.

LICENSE.name: Original project license
LICENSE.description: Preserved project license; renderer and font notices are separate.

GET /.name: GET /
GET /.description: List all Pet rows and render index.html.

GET /add-pet.name: GET /add-pet
GET /add-pet.description: GET renders the form; a nonempty submitted form constructs and commits a Pet then redirects to index.

POST /add-pet.name: POST /add-pet
POST /add-pet.description: GET renders the form; a nonempty submitted form constructs and commits a Pet then redirects to index.

GET /pet/<id>.name: GET /pet/<id>
GET /pet/<id>.description: Look up a Pet or raise 404 and render pet.html.

GET /edit/<id>.name: GET /edit/<id>
GET /edit/<id>.description: Look up the Pet; GET renders its values and a submitted form overwrites fields and commits before redirect.

POST /edit/<id>.name: POST /edit/<id>
POST /edit/<id>.description: Look up the Pet; GET renders its values and a submitted form overwrites fields and commits before redirect.

GET /delete/<id>.name: GET /delete/<id>
GET /delete/<id>.description: State-changing GET: delete the selected Pet, commit and redirect to index. No auth guard is present.

GET /arthas.name: GET /arthas
GET /arthas.description: Return a fixed demonstration string; no database mutation.
